_comment: Manually transcribed from each syllabus's own text (output/txt/*.txt after conceptgraph textract), not inferred or invented. 'provenance' quotes the exact source line so the figures can be checked against the PDFs. 'internal_prerequisites' lists course_codes, from this same 4-course set, that a course's own syllabus names as a prerequisite; empty means the syllabus names none of our other three courses (its stated prerequisites, if any, are external — see 'external_prerequisites').

external_prerequisites: Introduction to mathematics: functions, sequences, equations, inequalities, trigonometry
CALC.provenance: Syllabus_Calculus.pdf: 'ECTS credits / 6 (180 hours)'; 'Prerequisites « Introduction to mathematics»: functions, sequences, equations, inequalities, trigonometry'

LINALG.provenance: Syllabus_Linear_Algebra.pdf: 'ECTS credits / 3 (90 hours)'; 'Prerequisites You do not need advanced mathematics to join this course.'

ML.provenance: Syllabus_Machine_Learning.pdf: 'ECTS credits / 6'; 'Prerequisites ... Recommended prerequisite courses include “Programming Concepts” and “Data Manipulation Essentials.”'

PROB.provenance: Syllabus_Probability_essentials.pdf: 'Amount of ECTS credits: 4 credits'; 'Prerequisites: None'
